panel.title: Keep Awake
panel.keep_display_desc: When off, the monitor may dim, sleep and lock while the system stays awake

toast.busy: Keep Awake is busy — try again in a second
toast.lost_desc: The inhibit holder went silent; its locks were reclaimed by Noctalia and logind.
toast.partial_gate_desc: Running with the logind inhibit only.

tooltip.scope_partial: partial — display may sleep, auto-suspend blocked

error.spawn: could not start the inhibit holder (stream limit reached)
error.holder_timeout: the inhibit holder did not report within {seconds} s

default_scope.label: Default scope
default_scope.description: partial = system awake, monitor may dim/sleep/lock (auto-suspend is refused); full = every idle behaviour suppressed

durations.label: Duration choices (minutes)
durations.description: One positive integer per entry; shown as tiles in the panel in this order

show_remaining_text.label: Show remaining time beside the bar icon

activate_on_left_click.label: Left click re-activates last choice
activate_on_left_click.description: Off: left click opens the panel. Right click always turns Keep Awake off; middle click always toggles the last choice.

notify.label: Notify on changes
notify.description: Desktop notification when Keep Awake turns on, off, expires or is extended (Noctalia v5 has no plugin toast/OSD API)
